pairs.subject: embedded-db
pairs.evidence: src/lib/db.ts:66 Bootstrap sets WAL but ignores the pragma's returned effective mode and never sets or asserts a sync level, so a silent fallback (or the per-connection sync default) changes the durability contract without any diagnostic.

techniques.evidence: src/lib/db.ts:66 Mode requested but the result is not compared against the contract; no `synchronous` pragma anywhere in src/ or scripts/; no sidecar-aware backup or export path found.

src/lib/cli-spend-db.ts:33 Append-only spend ledger with no named reaper (the only `DELETE FROM cli_spend` is in tests); no per-table usage report. review_snapshots does have a keep-newest-N prune (feature-matrix-db.ts:774), but it has no dry-run or age floor.
src/lib/db.ts:873 The shared statement choke point has no latency recording, per-table key or slow-operation counting; no instrument wraps the connection.
src/lib/db.ts:28 One process-wide synchronous better-sqlite3 connection singleton; no pool exists to size or instrument.
src/lib/db.ts:65 Bootstrap runs only pragmas and DDL; a repo-wide search for loadExtension found nothing outside tests, so no extension is registered.
